questions.text:
प्रवास के निम्नलिखित कारकों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और 'प्रतिकर्ष कारक' से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. शांति व स्थायित्व
II. संपत्ति की सुरक्षा
III. महामारियाँ
IV. प्रतिकूल जलवायु
विकल्प :
(A) केवल I और II सही हैं
(B) केवल II और III सही हैं
(C) केवल III और IV सही हैं
(D) केवल I और IV सही हैं
questions.text_english:
Read the following factors of migration carefully and choose the correct option related to 'push factor':
I. Peace and stability
II. Protection of property
III. Epidemics
IV. Unpleasant climate
Options:
(A) Only I and II are correct
(B) Only II and III are correct
(C) Only III and IV are correct
(D) Only I and IV are correct

options.A: केवल I और II सही हैं
options.B: केवल II और III सही हैं
options.C: केवल III और IV सही हैं
options.D: केवल I और IV सही हैं

options_english.A: Only I and II are correct
options_english.B: Only II and III are correct
options_english.C: Only III and IV are correct
options_english.D: Only I and IV are correct

questions.solution: Push factors are the negative conditions that force people to migrate, such as epidemics (III) and unpleasant climate (IV). Therefore, options III and IV are the correct push factors.
questions.topic: Push and Pull factors of migration

questions.text:
'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय श्रम संगठन' द्वारा प्रस्तावित मानव विकास का उपागम निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा है ?
(A) आय
(B) कल्याण
(C) क्षमता
(D) आधारभूत आवश्यकता
questions.text_english:
'International Labour Organisation' initiated which one of the following approaches of Human Development ?
(A) Income
(B) Welfare
(C) Capability
(D) Basic Needs
questions.solution: The Basic Needs approach was proposed by the International Labour Organisation (ILO). It emphasizes providing essential requirements like health, education, and sanitation to improve the quality of life.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार का कृषि का संबंध एकल फ़सल के उत्पादन से है ?
(A) गहन निर्वाह कृषि
(B) रोपण कृषि
(C) मिश्रित कृषि
(D) भूमध्यसागरीय कृषि
questions.text_english:
Which one of the following types of agriculture is concerned with the production of a single crop?
(A) Intensive subsistence agriculture
(B) Plantation agriculture
(C) Mixed farming
(D) Mediterranean agriculture
questions.solution: Plantation agriculture is a system where large-scale farming is dedicated to the production of a single crop, such as tea, coffee, rubber, or sugarcane, typically for commercial purposes.

questions.text:
स्तम्भ I का मिलान स्तम्भ II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
स्तम्भ I (उद्योग) | स्तम्भ II (उदाहरण)
1. कृषि-आधारित | (i) साबुन
2. वन-आधारित | (ii) नमक
3. रसायन-आधारित | (iii) लाख
4. उत्पाद-आधारित | (iv) वनस्पति तेल
विकल्प :
(A) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(i)
(B) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(i), 4-(ii)
(C) 1-(iv), 2-(iii), 3-(ii), 4-(i)
(D) 1-(iv), 2-(iii), 3-(i), 4-(ii)
questions.text_english:
Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option:
Column I (Industry) | Column II (Example)
1. Agro-based | (i) Soaps
2. Forest-based | (ii) Salts
3. Chemical-based | (iii) Lac
4. Product-based | (iv) Vegetable oil
Options:
(A) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(i)
(B) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(i), 4-(ii)
(C) 1-(iv), 2-(iii), 3-(ii), 4-(i)
(D) 1-(iv), 2-(iii), 3-(i), 4-(ii)
questions.solution: Correct matching: Agro-based industry produces vegetable oil (1-iv). Forest-based industry produces lac (2-iii). Chemical-based industry produces salts (3-ii). Product-based industry produces soap (4-i). Therefore, (C) is correct.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं । ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
अभिकथन (A) : जनशक्ति सेवा क्षेत्रक का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण कारक है।
कारण (R) : अधिकांश तृतीयक क्रियाकलापों का निष्पादन कुशल श्रमिक और व्यावसायिक दृष्टि से प्रशिक्षित विशेषज्ञों द्वारा किया जाता है ।
विकल्प :
(A) (A) सही है, परंतु (R) ग़लत है ।
(B) (A) ग़लत है, परंतु (R) सही है ।
(C) (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
(D) (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): Manpower is an important component of the service sector.
Reason (R): Most of the tertiary activities are performed by skilled labour and professionally trained experts.
Options:
(A) (A) is true, but (R) is false.
(B) (A) is false, but (R) is true.
(C) Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
(D) Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

options.C: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.D: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.C: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.D: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Tertiary activities, or the service sector, heavily rely on human expertise, skill, and specialized training. Thus, both the assertion and the reason are true, and the reason correctly explains why manpower is crucial to the service sector.

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन I एवं II के रूप में दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
कथन I : अधिकांश चतुर्थक क्रियाकलापों का बाह्यस्रोतन किया जा सकता है ।
कथन II : ये सेवाएँ अनिवार्य रूप से संसाधनों तथा बाज़ार पर आधारित नहीं होती हैं ।
विकल्प :
(A) कथन I सही है, परंतु कथन II ग़लत है ।
(B) कथन I ग़लत है, परंतु कथन II सही है ।
(C) कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं और कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या है ।
(D) कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below as I and II. Read both the statements carefully and choose the correct option:
Statement I: Most of the quaternary activities can be outsourced.
Statement II: These services are not necessarily based on resources and market.
Options:
(A) Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
(B) Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.
(C) Statements I and II both are correct and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I.
(D) Statements I and II both are correct, but Statement II is not the correct explanation of Statement I.

options.A: कथन I सही है, परंतु कथन II ग़लत है ।
options.B: कथन I ग़लत है, परंतु कथन II सही है ।
options.C: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं और कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.D: कथन I और II दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कथन II, कथन I की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Statement I is correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
options_english.B: Statement I is incorrect, but Statement II is correct.
options_english.C: Statements I and II both are correct and Statement II is the correct explanation of Statement I.
options_english.D: Statements I and II both are correct, but Statement II is not the correct explanation of Statement I.

questions.solution: Quaternary activities involve specialized knowledge and research, which can be outsourced, unlike primary or secondary activities that depend on resources. Both statements are accurate and connected logically.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समुद्री मार्ग वैंकूवर और योकोहामा को जोड़ता है ?
(A) दक्षिण अटलांटिक समुद्री मार्ग
(B) उत्तर प्रशांत समुद्री मार्ग
(C) उत्तर अटलांटिक समुद्री मार्ग
(D) भूमध्य सागर हिंद महासागर समुद्री मार्ग
questions.text_english:
Which of the following sea route connects Vancouver and Yokohama?
(A) South Atlantic sea route
(B) North Pacific sea route
(C) North Atlantic sea route
(D) Mediterranean - Indian Ocean sea route

options.D: भूमध्य सागर हिंद महासागर समुद्री मार्ग

questions.solution: The North Pacific sea route links the ports on the western coast of North America (such as Vancouver) to the ports in East Asia (such as Yokohama, Japan).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक 'आंत्रपो पत्तन' का उदाहरण है ?
(A) अबादान
(B) माराकाइबो
(C) सिंगापुर
(D) त्रिपोली
questions.text_english:
Which of the following is an example of 'Entrepôt Port'?
(A) Abadan
(B) Maracaibo
(C) Singapore
(D) Tripoli
questions.solution: An entrepôt port is a port of call where goods are imported, stored, and then re-exported. Singapore is a world-renowned example of an entrepôt port due to its strategic location on global trade routes.

questions.text:
स्तम्भ I का मिलान स्तम्भ II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
स्तम्भ I (रेल मंडल) | स्तम्भ II (मुख्यालय)
1. नॉर्थ ईस्टर्न | (i) जबलपुर
2. वेस्ट सेंट्रल | (ii) हाजीपुर
3. ईस्ट सेंट्रल | (iii) सिकंदराबाद
4. साउथ सेंट्रल | (iv) गोरखपुर
विकल्प :
(A) 1-(i), 2-(iv), 3-(iii), 4-(ii)
(B) 1-(i), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(iii)
(C) 1-(iv), 2-(i), 3-(ii), 4-(iii)
(D) 1-(iv), 2-(i), 3-(iii), 4-(ii)
questions.text_english:
Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option:
Column I (Railway Zones) | Column II (Headquarters)
1. North Eastern | (i) Jabalpur
2. West Central | (ii) Hajipur
3. East Central | (iii) Secunderabad
4. South Central | (iv) Gorakhpur
Options:
(A) 1-(i), 2-(iv), 3-(iii), 4-(ii)
(B) 1-(i), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(iii)
(C) 1-(iv), 2-(i), 3-(ii), 4-(iii)
(D) 1-(iv), 2-(i), 3-(iii), 4-(ii)
questions.solution: Correct match: North Eastern Railway has its headquarters in Gorakhpur (1-iv). West Central Railway has its headquarters in Jabalpur (2-i). East Central Railway has its headquarters in Hajipur (3-ii). South Central Railway has its headquarters in Secunderabad (4-iii). Therefore, (C) is correct.

questions.text:
2016 – 17 में भारत द्वारा निम्नलिखित निर्यात की गई वस्तुओं/माल को उनके प्रतिशत के घटते हुए क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. अपरिष्कृत और पेट्रोलियम उत्पाद

III. कृषि और समवर्गी उत्पाद

(A) I, II, III, IV
(B) II, I, IV, III

questions.text_english:
Arrange the following commodities of Indian export during 2016-17 in descending order of their percentages and choose the correct option:
I. Crude and petroleum products
II. Manufactured goods
III. Agriculture and allied products
IV. Ore and minerals
Options:
(A) I, II, III, IV
(B) II, I, IV, III
(C) III, II, I, IV
(D) II, III, I, IV
questions.solution: Based on Indian export data for 2016-17, the descending order of commodities is: Manufactured goods (largest share), followed by Crude and petroleum products, then Ore and minerals, and lastly Agriculture and allied products. Thus, option (B) is the correct sequence.

questions.text:
भारत में पेट्रोलियम एवं उर्वरकों के आयात करने के लिए निम्नलिखित में से किस समुद्री पत्तन को विशेष रूप से विकसित किया गया है ?
(A) मुंबई
(B) मार्मागाओ
(C) कांडला
(D) कोच्चि
questions.text_english:
Which of the following sea ports in India has been developed specially to import petroleum and fertilizers ?
(A) Mumbai
(B) Marmagao
(C) Kandla
(D) Kochchi
questions.solution: Kandla port was specifically developed after partition to serve as a major hub for importing petroleum, fertilizers, and other industrial raw materials to the northern and western parts of India.

questions.text:

questions.text_english:
'North-South Corridor' connects which of the following two terminal places?
(A) Srinagar and Kanyakumari
(B) Delhi and Kanyakumari
(C) Amritsar and Chennai
(D) Srinagar and Chennai
questions.solution: The North-South Corridor is part of the National Highways Development Project (NHDP), connecting Srinagar in the north to Kanyakumari in the south.

questions.text:

questions.text_english:
Which one of the following is an example of solid waste?
(A) Kitchen discarded items
(B) Polythene bags
(C) Plant leaves and branches
(D) Old newspapers
questions.solution: While all options listed could be considered waste, polythene bags are a classic example of non-biodegradable solid waste that causes significant environmental pollution.
questions.chapter: Geographical Perspectives on Selected Issues and Problems

questions.text:
भू-प्रदूषण के निम्नलिखित स्रोतों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. अनुचित मानव क्रियाकलाप
II. अनुपचारित औद्योगिक अपशिष्ट
III. आदिकालीन निर्वाह कृषि कार्य
IV. पीड़कनाशियों एवं उर्वरकों का उपयोग
विकल्प :
(A) केवल I, II और III सही हैं
(B) केवल II, III और IV सही हैं
(C) केवल I, II और IV सही हैं
(D) केवल I, III और IV सही हैं
questions.text_english:
Read the following sources of land pollution carefully and choose the correct option:
I. Improper human activities
II. Untreated industrial waste
III. Practice of primitive subsistence agriculture
IV. Use of pesticides and fertilizers
Options:
(A) Only I, II and III are correct
(B) Only II, III and IV are correct
(C) Only I, II and IV are correct
(D) Only I, III and IV are correct

options.A: केवल I, II और III सही हैं
options.B: केवल II, III और IV सही हैं
options.C: केवल I, II और IV सही हैं
options.D: केवल I, III और IV सही हैं

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct
options_english.C: Only I, II and IV are correct
options_english.D: Only I, III and IV are correct

questions.solution: Land pollution is caused by improper human activities (I), industrial waste (II), and the excessive use of pesticides and fertilizers (IV). Primitive subsistence agriculture (III) typically has minimal impact on large-scale land pollution.
questions.chapter: Geographical Perspectives on Selected Issues and Problems

questions.text:
दिए गए अनुच्छेद को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और प्रश्न संख्या (18.1) से (18.3) के उत्तर लिखिए :
[Passage Text - Dharavi]
(18.1) धारावी की भौतिक स्थिति का वर्णन कीजिए ।
(18.2) धारावी की एक प्रमुख समस्या की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
(18.3) धारावी के संदर्भ में स्वच्छ भारत मिशन के प्रमुख उद्देश्य को स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Read the given passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:
[Passage Text - Dharavi]
(18.1) Describe the physical condition of Dharavi.
(18.2) Explain one major problem of Dharavi.
(18.3) Swachh Bharat context of Dharavi.

sub_questions.text: धारावी की भौतिक स्थिति का वर्णन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe the physical condition of Dharavi.
sub_questions.solution: Dharavi is characterized by temporary, multi-storeyed buildings with narrow alleys where even a bicycle cannot pass, and residents live in cramped conditions with very limited sunlight.

questions.text: मानव-पर्यावरण संबंधों की दो संकल्पनाओं के बीच नव-निश्चयवाद संतुलन बनाने का प्रयास करता है । उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की परख कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Neo-determinism attempts to strike a balance between two concepts of man-environment relations. Examine this statement with examples.

key_points: Neo-determinism acts as a middle path between environmental determinism and possibilism.
It argues that humans can modify the environment but within the limits set by nature.
Example: Sustainable development and climate-conscious infrastructure planning.

questions.solution: Neo-determinism, also known as stop-and-go determinism, serves as a bridge between environmental determinism, which claims nature controls humans, and possibilism, which argues humans can overcome nature entirely. It suggests that while humans can innovate and transform their surroundings, they must respect ecological boundaries. For example, modern sustainable development practices emphasize technological advancement while maintaining a balance that prevents environmental degradation, such as building cities that adapt to local climate constraints rather than ignoring them.

questions.text: विश्व में विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी किस प्रकार जनसंख्या वृद्धि में सहायता करते हैं ? व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: How do science and technology help in population growth in the world? Explain.

key_points: Advancements in medical science reduced mortality rates.
Improved food production techniques increased food availability.
Technological tools enhanced sanitation and public health.

questions.solution: Science and technology have played a significant role in accelerating global population growth by drastically reducing death rates. Medical breakthroughs, such as vaccinations, antibiotics, and improved surgical techniques, have controlled various diseases and increased life expectancy. Furthermore, advancements in agricultural technology, including high-yielding crop varieties and improved irrigation, have boosted food production, supporting larger populations. Enhanced public health and sanitation systems have also minimized the spread of epidemics, thereby allowing more people to survive into reproductive age.

questions.text_english:
(a) Describe any three factors responsible for the development of different types of rural settlements in India.
OR
(b) Describe any three features of dispersed settlements in India.

key_points: Physical factors: Relief, climate, water availability.
Socio-cultural factors: Caste, religion, ethnic structure.
Historical factors: Defence, land tenure systems.

questions.solution: The development of different types of rural settlements in India is influenced by several factors. Physical factors like terrain, climate, and access to water play a major role in determining if a settlement is compact or dispersed. Socio-cultural factors such as caste and religious groups often lead to segregated or cluster-based settlements. Historical factors, including defense needs and land tenure systems that existed in the past, also significantly dictate the layout and density of rural settlements across different regions in India.

questions.text:
(क) सतत पोषणीय विकास के संदर्भ में उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
अथवा
(ख) मानव विकास का कल्याण उपागम का जो मानव विकास का विकास करने पर होता है । उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Explain this statement with examples in the context of sustainable development.
OR
(b) The welfare approach of human development focuses on the development of human beings. Explain this statement with examples.

key_points: Sustainable Development: Meeting present needs without compromising future resources.
Example: Renewable energy use vs. fossil fuels.
Welfare Approach: Focuses on education, health, and basic amenities.

questions.solution: Sustainable development is the process of meeting present-day needs without depleting natural resources for future generations. For instance, transitioning from fossil fuels to renewable energy sources like solar power helps meet current energy demands while preserving the environment for the future. Alternatively, the welfare approach to human development prioritizes investment in education, healthcare, and basic sanitation for individuals. By focusing on improving the lives of human beings through these essential services, governments aim to create a healthier, more capable population, which in turn leads to overall societal progress.

questions.text: विश्व में कृषि के प्रकारों का विस्तृत वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Describe the types of agriculture in the world in detail.

key_points: Dairy farming, Mediterranean farming, and Market gardening.

questions.solution: Agriculture around the world varies significantly based on climate, topography, and technological development. Primitive subsistence agriculture involves small-scale farming for personal consumption using traditional tools. In contrast, intensive subsistence agriculture is practiced in densely populated regions, producing high yields on small land plots. Plantation agriculture focuses on large-scale commercial production of a single crop like tea or coffee. Mixed farming combines crop cultivation with livestock rearing to ensure multiple income streams. Furthermore, commercial grain farming, dairy farming, and Mediterranean farming demonstrate high levels of specialization based on the specific market demand and regional environmental conditions of different countries.

questions.text: विश्व में उद्योगों के अवस्थिति को प्रभावित करने वाले कारकों का वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Describe the factors affecting the location of industries in the world.

key_points: Availability of cheap and skilled labour.

questions.solution: The location of industries is determined by a complex interplay of various factors. Access to raw materials is critical, as it reduces transport costs; industries often locate near resource sites. Markets are equally vital, as industries need proximity to consumers to sell their goods. The availability of abundant, cheap, and skilled labor is another essential factor for manufacturing efficiency. Furthermore, access to reliable energy sources, like coal, hydroelectricity, or oil, is necessary to run heavy machinery. Lastly, government policies, such as subsidies or special industrial zones, and the quality of transport infrastructure significantly influence where businesses decide to establish their factories.

questions.text: भारत के संदर्भ में जल संसाधनों के संरक्षण की आवश्यकता पर विस्तार से प्रकाश डालिए ।
questions.text_english: Discuss the need for conservation of water resources in the context of India in detail.

key_points: Need for sustainable water management policies.

questions.solution: Water is a finite and indispensable resource in India, yet its scarcity is becoming a critical issue. The country faces high water demand due to a large, growing population, rapid urbanization, and extensive agricultural needs. India experiences highly uneven distribution of rainfall, leading to seasonal floods in some areas and severe droughts in others. Furthermore, widespread pollution of surface water sources like rivers and lakes, along with the alarming over-exploitation of groundwater for industrial and agricultural purposes, has significantly lowered water tables. Consequently, there is an urgent need to adopt sustainable water management practices, such as rainwater harvesting and efficient irrigation, to ensure water security.

questions.text: भारत में खनिज संसाधनों के वितरण का विस्तृत वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Describe the distribution of mineral resources in India in detail.
questions.solution: India is endowed with a rich variety of mineral resources, primarily concentrated in the ancient crystalline rocks of the Peninsular plateau. Iron ore is found in major belts across states like Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, and Karnataka. Coal resources, which are essential for energy, are largely located in the Gondwana fields in the eastern states. Bauxite, manganese, and copper deposits are also scattered throughout the peninsula, reflecting the diverse geological history of the region. This distribution is essential to understand because it dictates the location of major heavy industries, particularly steel plants, which are situated in close proximity to these mineral-rich zones.

questions.text: भारत में प्रवास के कारणों और परिणामों का वर्णन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Describe the causes and consequences of migration in India.

key_points: Economic causes: Better job opportunities, rural-urban migration.
Social consequences: Cultural diversity, urban challenges.
Demographic consequences: Changes in age-sex structure.

questions.solution: Migration in India is driven by both economic and social factors. Economic factors, such as the search for better job opportunities and higher wages in cities, are the primary drivers of rural-to-urban migration. Social factors like marriage and the need for higher education are also significant. The consequences of this migration are profound. Economically, migrants send remittances back to their rural homes, which improves living standards, but the rural areas also experience a 'brain drain' of skilled youth. Socially, migration promotes cultural diversity in urban areas, though it also creates challenges like the growth of slums, housing shortages, and pressure on urban infrastructure.
